name: Burning Blade Medallion
label: Quest

intro: Assigned by the warlock Zureetha Fargaze, this task sends young Horde initiates deep into the Burning Blade Coven cave in the Valley of Trials. There, players must confront a hidden cultist and recover an artifact of dark magic known as the Burning Blade Medallion. The mission reveals that demonic corruption is actively taking root right under the Horde's nose.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.
It is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.
But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.
Go, friend. You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is your task complete, friend? Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials. But I fear they have further aims in our land.
We have not seen the end of them.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
